purpose: Count raw image reference URLs in 273 Korean master series and 12-theme catalog, separating data storage from actual runtime external network fetches.

sources.note: Active site-side routing to two owner-controlled Cloudflare Pages archives; fallback uses local image placeholder rather than origin host.

method: Read-only JSON scan of card.image in all series and theme groups; sourceImage is provenance metadata, not a displayed image ref. External route classification mirrors the supported hosts, file extensions and official wmimages path checks in card-image-cdn.js. No network requests to origin or archive; not HTTP 200, asset decoding, visual identity or deployment proof.

interpretation.routeVsHTTP: Routeability alone is not evidence a Cloudflare archive file exists/decodes; per-file and live network audits still required.

nextSteps: Inspect actual browser Network requests after CDN routing on representative sets.
Verify owned Cloudflare Pages archive HTTP status and WEBP decoding across unverified assets.
Only then replace remaining card.image original external URLs with self-hosted archive URLs while retaining sourceImage provenance.
Regenerate counts and CI validation; do not change collection ownership or theme review checkpoint with this reference audit.
